enabled_when: a non-trivial task profile and at least one project area subsystem architecture item dependency contract or issue-lineage signal are selected
refined inspection identifies changed facts paths symbols architecture relationships contracts dependencies or issue lineage
delivery_rules: accepted plus current entries may be candidate constraints only after canonical-owner revalidation
revalidation-required entries are warnings rather than current constraints
contradicted entries block a definitive conclusion and route to the decision owner
observed proposed unresolved historical and superseded entries remain lazy unless explicitly requested

conditional_context.when: promotion revalidation contradiction supersession routing repair or authority semantics require the portable owner
an explicit project-knowledge lifecycle operation is selected
an authorized promotion record is drafted or repaired
an authorized route shard is created or repaired

expand_when: selected knowledge conflicts with repository evidence
a dependency or public contract freshness trigger changed
the packet limit omits equally relevant constraints
budget_behavior: load the root index then only matching shard descriptors and bounded selected entries; never load all shards by default
context_receipt: current warnings blocked and omitted items
